verdicts.reason: A leaves a dead empty band on the left with the text block starting about 160px in. The legal line is crammed beside the CTA and wraps to two ragged lines, and the book sits small, tilted and off its circle, which is pushed into the right corner. B reads left to right as a banner should (headline, book, CTA). But the headline and copy are jammed against the top and left edges with almost no margin, the legal line is nearly as large as the subhead, and the circle now sits behind the CTA instead of framing the book.
